note: Hand-written Asana task descriptions, by act-id: tools/asana_setup.py --rewrite-task <act-id> puts one on its task. Nothing else in the build writes a description.

act-cal-working-day-ticks: On some calendar sheets the guardian may have ticked the days the pump worked, instead of marking the days it was broken.
Read as breakdowns, those ticks would count working days as downtime, so a person has to look at each listed sheet and say which it is.
2. For each row, click "Open photo" and look at the guardian's marks.
3. In "Marks are", choose one option per row: Breakdown marks, Working-day ticks or Can't tell. Add a comment if it helps.
Closes when: every row has a choice and the workbook link is posted here as a comment starting "Evidence:".
Owner, due date and completion on the weekly report come from this task; ticking it closes the action only once evidence is posted (an 'Evidence:' comment or a file).
